lead: A guided tour: it highlights one element of the page at a time, with a description card beside it and next / previous / finish. Esc or the × in the top right closes it; the card flips to the other side when it doesn't fit, and the highlight follows the target when it scrolls or the page resizes.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `tour.css`; the card's shell comes from `popover.css`.
styling.root: Root of the mask layer (under `body`). The target's rectangle is written to its `--tour-x` / `--tour-y` / `--tour-w` / `--tour-h` (pixels, unitless); `data-ready` once placed, `data-no-target` when the step has no target
styling.mask: The full-screen layer that blocks clicks; the highlight box that follows the target (a huge `box-shadow` dims everything around it)
styling.center: A step without a target: a full-screen centering container holding the card
styling.card: The description card; its shell (background, shadow, arrow) is the theme style's popover
styling.footer: The footer; the progress (the current dot has `data-active`); the buttons
